bucket.apiAccessNote: Images convert to WebP before upload. Create API keys below for scripts and agents.
bucket.docsStorageBody: Buckets are paid monthly from your ICPay balance. Files stay encrypted at rest on the canister.
bucket.docsImagesOnly: Images (any format in the picker — stored as WebP), plus txt, py, and zip
bucket.docsEncrypted: Encrypted at rest with per-bucket keys
bucket.docsCdnBody: Public buckets expose copyable links on the IC raw HTTP gateway (per-canister host):
bucket.docsCdnPrivate: Private buckets have no public URL — download with downloadFile while signed in.
bucket.docsApiBody: Call these update/query methods on the ICPay backend canister with Internet Identity or a bucket API key:
bucket.docsApiCanister: Canister ID: {id}. Sign in through ICPay or use @dfinity/agent with your Internet Identity delegation.
bucket.docsApiKeysBody: Create keys in the bucket detail page. Pass the secret as the optional last argument on uploadFile and deleteFile.
bucket.docsPaginationBody: Files load {size} per page from the canister to keep queries fast.
bucket.apiKeysHint: Keys are scoped to this bucket. The secret is shown once — copy it when created.
bucket.apiKeyCreatedBody: This secret will not be shown again.
bucket.docsWebpNote: All images — including SVG, PNG, and JPEG — are converted to WebP and compressed to about 1 MB in the app before upload. The canister stores image/webp only.
